high_level_description: The image features a gradient background that transitions from a light gray at the top to a warm orange-red hue towards the bottom. The text is prominently displayed in white, with a slightly blurred effect that gives it a soft, almost ethereal appearance. The text reads: "I've heard that the roads on the Yamuna Expressway have provisions to land jets, in times of need. Art and its effects that I carry through, make Chennai look similar." The mood of the image is contemplative and somewhat surreal, due to the combination of the gradient background and the poetic nature of the text.
